meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 给项目加入 Telegram 机器人支持:复制并注册 Telegram 适配器及配对、Markdown 清洗辅助代码与测试,安装固定版本依赖包,构建并跑注册测试,再引导你在 BotFather 建 bot、存 token、重启服务,最后用 4 位配对码把你的 Telegram 聊天绑定给 agent。
howto.when: 当你要让 agent 接入 Telegram 频道时触发:在 /setup 流程中,或之后用 /init-first-agent、/manage-channels 接线时。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 频道加上
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并构建
写入 .env 并同步进容器
终端打印 4 位码,发给 bot 即绑定

howto.what_en: Adds Telegram bot support: copies and registers the Telegram adapter plus pairing and markdown helpers with their tests, installs the pinned package, builds, runs the registration test, then guides bot creation, token storage, restart and a 4-digit pairing handshake.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want the agent on Telegram — during the /setup flow, or later via /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add the Telegram channel for me
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds
Stored in .env and synced to the container
Prints a 4-digit code; send it to the bot
